runtimeResult.message: Headless execution requires clarification before a repository plan can be created.

promptUnderstanding.reply: I need the target runtime boundary identified before a read-only repository investigation can be scoped.
promptUnderstanding.conversationSummary: The user requests a read-only explanation of a runtime boundary with file citations. No files may be edited; .env, .git/**, and bun.lock are protected. Run `bun test` only when appropriate.

refinedBrief.goal: Explain one specified runtime boundary using repository-file evidence, without editing files.
deliverables: A concise explanation of the selected runtime boundary.
Citations to repository files that substantiate the explanation.
Relevant test evidence if `bun test` is appropriate and available.
constraints: Read-only investigation; no writer paths are allowed.
Do not modify protected paths: .env, .git/**, or bun.lock.
Do not infer or authorize changes.
Use clear English for all authored output.
acceptanceCriteria: The explanation names the selected boundary and the components or processes on each side.
Each material claim is supported by cited repository files.
Any validation run is reported accurately, including limitations.

questions.prompt: Which runtime boundary should be explained?
questions.rationale: The request does not identify the process, component, or interface whose boundary must be traced.

options.label: End-to-end runtime
options.description: Trace the primary application path across its major runtime layers.

options.label: CLI to backend
options.description: Trace the boundary between command-line entry points and backend or sidecar execution.

options.label: Frontend to backend
options.description: Trace the boundary between the user interface and backend or sidecar execution.
